description:
Formulated by a rosacea sufferer and tested by Harley Street Dermatologists, its range of products are plant-based, effective, and affordable. The philosophy at Finca Skin Organics is to provide accessible skincare products to anyone who has physical or emotional discomfort with their skin due to conditions such as rosacea.

All of the formulations have one thing in common, a short ingredients list, and all of the ingredients are plant-based, to avoid further irritation to already sensitive skin.

Calming Serum 1 - For soothing dry, red and irritated skin commonly associated with ETR subtype 1 rosacea

We have designed this soothing and anti-inflammatory serum with calming ingredients to reduce redness and eliminate tight feeling skin.
This serum helps to reduce TWL (transepidermal water loss) across the skin and helps repair your skin's protective barrier.

• Our formulation was specifically developed for sensitive skin including subtype 1 ETR rosacea
• Your skin will feel different within a couple of days and look different within a week
• Contains organic rosehip oil and hyaluronic acid to soothe and plump the skin
• Does not contain essential oils or perfumes; both are known to irritate sensitive faces

How to use:
• Gently shake the bottle before use to blend the natural oils and hyaluronic acid.
• Apply a few drops in the morning to a damp face and massage in. 
• Reapply throughout the day and at night as needed.
• Can be used in conjunction with our moisturising balm.
_____

Calming Serum 2 - Targets oily, red skin and the appearance of blemishes 

We've designed this calming, lightweight serum to target the symptoms of sensitive skin including subtype 2 acne rosacea.
This serum relieves facial redness, swelling, excess oil and reduces the appearance of acne-like breakouts and bumps.

• Our best-selling product
• Our formulation was specifically developed for sensitive skin including subtype 2 acne rosacea
• Most notice improvement within 3-4 weeks of regular use
• Does not contain azelaic acid, parabens or perfume

How to use:
• Use in the morning and last thing at night.
• Apply directly to affected areas including bumps, blemishes, and troubled skin.
• Can be used on its own or under moisturiser, sunscreen, or makeup.
• After 12 weeks many can reduce to once a day for maintenance.
• Can be used in conjunction with our moisturising balm.
_____

Moisturising Balm - For all skin types

This rich, ultra-moisturising plant-based balm can be used daily.

It soothes and hydrates the skin and includes natural UV protection. When used with one of the calming serums, the balm helps to lock in the serum and reduce TWL (transepidermal water loss) across the skin and improve the skin barrier function, which leads to a reduction in facial redness. Suitable for all skin types.

How to use:
• Apply a small amount of balm in the morning to clean damp skin and last thing at night.
• If using with a serum, wait a minute before applying balm on top of serum. 
_____

SPF 30 tinted sunscreen 
UV light is the number 1 trigger of rosacea flare-ups.
Our tinted sunscreen with SPF 30 reduces the appearance of redness while offering protection against harmful UVA/UVB.

Contains non-nano zinc oxide; the safest form of UV protection.
Our sunscreen is physical; it sits on top of the skin, unlike chemical sunscreens which penetrate the skin and may cause irritation to sensitive faces. Physical sunscreens are recommended by dermatologists for people with sensitive skin.
The majority of sunscreens on the market today have at least 25 ingredients, such a long list increases the chances of skin irritation. Ours has only 7 ingredients, which means it's perfect for sensitive skin types. 

Available in two shades; light to medium & medium to dark. Tint helps to reduce the appearance of redness.

How to use: 
• Shake well before use.
• For use all year round
• Apply 15 to 20 minutes before exposure to the sun.
• Reapply frequently, especially after swimming, exercise and towel drying.
